_readme: Retrieval test set for scripts/evalRetrieval.ts. A question is a hit when a retrieved chunk contains ANY of its `expect` phrases. Phrases are compared after lowercasing, removing accents and punctuation, and collapsing spaces. Add a question for every new document you upload. Questions with "set": "holdout" were written before tuning search (2026-11-12) and must never be used to tune it; they show whether a change generalizes.
